summary: Adds the repo-standard Apache-2.0 SPDX license field to two documentation-set scaffold package manifests so the license-policy gate can evaluate all package metadata deterministically.

reference_repo_reviewed.notes: Confirmed current reference shape includes OAuth token management, scheduled auth selection, cooldown queues, and OpenAI/Claude auth refresh code.
Confirmed credential_balancer manager/docs cover pool selection, health state, cooldown, and provider auth-manager registry integration.
Confirmed stock fetch OAuth refresh path and terminal refresh-token error taxonomy remain present.

stale_adr_handling: ADR decision records are status-bound rather than date-stale; Proposed ADR-0384 is provenance and design input, while Accepted ADR-0335, ADR-0363, ADR-0390, and ADR-0391 govern the live intelligence direction.
Generated ADR indexes and projection files were read as derived views only; no generated ADR mirror was hand edited.
The code change is independent of ADR status transitions and only closes a live license-policy gate finding.
nonclaims: No provider-pool runtime behavior changes are made in this PR.
No ADR status transition, generated index edit, or production rollout is claimed.
Remote CI and reviewer approval are still required before merge.

findings: The smallest durable fix is manifest metadata only; no new abstraction or dependency is introduced.
A deterministic license field keeps package metadata machine-checkable for CI and supply-chain review.
The license-policy gate was rerun after each manifest fix; the second run passed across 716 packages.
The chosen field matches the dominant repo convention, so future package authors see the expected manifest shape.
Targeted gate, package metadata, policy tests, diff check, and added-line audit passed.
Rejected changing the policy allowlist because Apache-2.0 is already allowed and is the dominant in-repo package license.
No secrets, runtime auth, network boundary, or executable source changes are introduced.
Manifest-only metadata change has no runtime performance path.
SPDX license declarations now allow the license-policy gate to prove allowed licensing for both scaffold crates.
cargo metadata reports Apache-2.0 for both touched packages.
No runtime observability surface is changed; gate output is the observable proof.
Both documentation-set scaffold crates now follow the same package metadata convention as neighboring workspace crates.

verification.summary: Both touched packages report license Apache-2.0
No added source or evidence line contains the audited ungrounded-pattern terms.

known_gaps: Full gate run-all was not rerun for this narrow metadata PR; prior active baseline still has unrelated supply-chain and stage0-prereqs failures queued separately.
Remote Jenkins/GitHub checks must run on the pushed PR head before merge.
